title: Multi-Objective Enterprise Green Supply Chain Network Design
abstract: arXiv:2609.11971v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper introduces and studies the Multi-Objective Enterprise Green Supply Chain Network Design problem (MOEDGSCND) an extension of the well known Multi-Objective Supply Chain Network Design (MO-SCND), in this case a three-objective combinatorial optimisation problem that simultaneously minimises total cost f1, carbon dioxide emissions f2, and customer dissatisfaction f3 over binary decisions on which distribution centres to open and how to assign customer zones to open facilities. The problem generalises capacitated facility location and is known to be NP-hard. Furthermore this paper lays out a formal specification of decision variables, objective functions, all constraints and then investigates and compares three solution approaches using a single numerical instance: (A) exact weighted-sum integer linear programming solved via PuLP, (B) three Fully Polynomial-Time Approximation Schemes (FPTAS) providing (.94 + $\epsilon$)-guarante

translated_title: 多目标企业绿色供应链网络设计
translated_abstract: 本文引入并研究了多目标企业绿色供应链网络设计问题（MOEDGSCND），这是著名的多目标供应链网络设计问题（MO-SCND）的扩展。该问题是一个三目标组合优化问题，通过关于开设哪些配送中心以及如何将客户区域分配给已开设设施的二元决策，同时最小化总成本 f₁、二氧化碳排放 f₂ 和客户不满意度 f₃。该问题是带容量约束设施选址问题的推广，已被证明是NP难问题。此外，本文对决策变量、目标函数及所有约束条件给出了形式化定义，并使用单一数值实例研究并比较了三种求解方法：（A）通过PuLP求解的精确加权和整数线性规划；（B）提供 (0.94 + ε) 保证的三种全多项式时间近似方案（FPTAS）……
tldr: 本文提出并形式化了多目标企业绿色供应链网络设计问题（MOEDGSCND），在同时最小化总成本、二氧化碳排放和客户不满意度的目标下，比较了精确整数线性规划与多种FPTAS近似算法的求解性能。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces and formally specifies the Multi-Objective Enterprise Green Supply Chain Network Design problem (MOEDGSCND), which simultaneously minimizes total cost, CO2 emissions, and customer dissatisfaction, and compares exact weighted-sum integer linear programming with multiple FPTAS approximation algorithms on a numerical instance.
